summary_md: **Cleiton Augusto ([@cleitonaugustob](https://x.com/cleitonaugustob/status/2115315131152556136))** reports a bypass in **airlock**, a prompt-injection plugin for Hermes Agent: with `approvals_off: block`, a gateway-run `hermes -z` turn could execute an action that required approval. It was fixed in 0.2.3; the GitHub security advisory has details.

referenced_urls.title: Approval-required actions run without approval in gateway-run `hermes -z` turns

relevance: A real approval-gate bypass in an agent harness plugin, with an advisory to learn from.
